transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I keep taking on more and more projects and plans at once, and I can’t seem to slow myself down even though everything in my life is starting to fall apart. I'm just so overwhelmed because I feel like I'm constantly spinning out of control.

During these times when you feel sped up and out of control, have you had things like hearing voices or strongly believing things others said weren’t true, and have you ever also had a separate period of at least two weeks where you felt very depressed or lost interest in almost everything?

Yes, I've been completely convinced that the IRS and a former client are secretly plotting to ruin my finances, though I don't hear voices and these thoughts only happen when I'm in this sped-up state. As for feeling deeply depressed or losing interest in things for two weeks, no, I've never experienced anything like that.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient describes a distinct sped-up state with loss of control, excessive goal-directed activity ('taking on more and more projects and plans'), and mood-congruent/persecutory delusional beliefs occurring only during that state. There is no history of a separate major depressive episode, and psychotic symptoms are not reported outside the manic state, supporting a manic episode with psychotic symptoms rather than schizoaffective or depressive-spectrum conditions.
